data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'naji' which means 'salvation' or 'deliverance'. This name is often given to girls who are considered a source of joy and happiness for their families. The name Nija carries the meaning “Joyful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nija usually hope their child will grow to embody joyful and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nija total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
